description: Email Channels parser/SMTP evidence slice after .14.2.1. Normalize sender, visible To/Cc addresses and hidden Bcc only from independently identified receiving account or confirmed outbound SMTP envelope; never from IMAP folder, Delivered-To alone, reply thread or historical participants. Preserve provider/account scope for IdentityResolver and per-message recipient Person resolution in Engine integration .4; fail closed on ambiguous/missing evidence. Tests FIRST on IMAP parser fixture, SMTP outbound result and mismatched accounts for sender copy, evolving To/Cc, no retroactive access, hidden Bcc confirmation, bot replies; property tests for recipient dedup and untrusted headers. No new Action/tool or credential changes unless read system-config; update Channels guide. New-feature E2E awaits human UX gate.
title: [zaq-emb.14.2.2] Normalize per-message email recipients
